resources.string: Add or choose a car first: the dyno measures the car shown.
Mass not set: the dyno needs it (driver and fuel included).
While measuring: the car with the driver, passengers and fuel. 10 kg off changes the power by less than 1 %.
Empty fields use the default shown. A saloon is about 0.6 to 0.7 m², an SUV 0.9 to 1.1. The driveline loss only changes the estimated engine power.
Car value to compare (torque or power)
No value of the active profile has the right unit
Choices come from the active profile (and the GPS speed). A profile holding only these values is read the fastest: more points per run. An ECU speed is better than the GPS one.
Armed: full throttle in one gear starts a run
Armed: tap Start at the beginning of the pull

resources.string: Few points: the curve is rough. A profile with fewer values gives more.
Fewer than 3 readings per second: peaks may be smoothed out.
The road is assumed flat: do runs both ways on the same stretch and compare.

• Only where it is legal and safe: a closed road or a track.
• Flat, straight road; do the same pull both ways and compare.
• One gear from low to high engine speed, full throttle; 3rd or 4th gear is best (in low gears the wheels and the gearbox take a part of the power that is not counted).
• Warm engine, windows closed, tyres at their usual pressure.
• Set the mass with the driver. The curve is the power reaching the road; the torque shown is that power at the engine, without the transmission losses.
Runs (tap one to show it, a second one to compare)
Its readings and its curve are deleted.
